name: tellymote-video
description: Motion graphics for TellyMote, rendered with Remotion

scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render Promo out/tellymote-promo-vo.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.build: npm run assets && npm run timing && npm run music && npm run render && npm run mix
scripts.still: npm run assets && remotion still Promo out/frame.png
